How does SCRIPE unify context-aware navigation and fail-closed route security?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE removes SupportsTenantGuidance and enforces one backend-driven authorization contract (AuthorizedRouteDescriptor) with a fail-closed RouteGuard and inline shell context gates.12

  1. Every protected route is inventoried in APP_ROUTE_MANIFEST (192 App Router pages) with zero SYSTEM_PAGES or module prefix bypasses.3
  2. MenuAccessEvaluator evaluates workspace, ancestor chain, PBAC, RoleMenuItem, context flags, and features identically for navigation trees and routes.2
  3. When a valid user lacks an active tenant or platform context, RouteGuard mounts a reusable shell gate inside DashboardLayout instead of the page.4
  4. Backend APIs block cross-tenant dashboard MRR leaks, null == null webhook IDORs, system_settings escalation, and unauthenticated workspace enumeration.5

What connects the Next.js RouteGuard and .NET MenuAccessEvaluator?

Diagram structure
  • Next.js Proxy proxy
  • RouteGuard guard
  • Route Manifest manifest
  • Shell Gates gates
  • Context Switcher switcher
  • Menus API nav_api
  • Tenants Switchable tenants_api
  • MenuAccessEvaluator evaluator
  • TenantMiddleware middleware
  • proxy → guard · Cookie gate
  • guard → manifest · Match binding
  • guard → nav_api · Load descriptors
  • nav_api → evaluator · Evaluate rules
  • guard → gates · Mount gate
  • gates → switcher · Pick tenant
  • switcher → tenants_api · List eligible
  • switcher → middleware · Set context
  1. Next.js Proxy ↗

    Enforces scr_auth_state on manifest-protected paths at SSR while passing public and unknown 404 routes through.

  2. Route Manifest ↗

    APP_ROUTE_MANIFEST and fail-closed PAGE_PERMISSIONS replace SYSTEM_PAGES with a 192-route parity test.

  3. MenuAccessEvaluator ↗

    Computes AccessState (authorized, tenant_context_required, platform_context_required, feature_disabled) without DB schema changes.

  4. Shell Gates ↗

    Renders TenantContextRequiredGate, FeatureUnavailableGate, or PlatformContextRequiredGate before page children mount.

  5. Context Switcher ↗

    Loads tenants.drill_down and identity_context.switch candidates inline and re-validates without /tenants detours.

2

How does direct URL access resolve across states?

Diagram structure
  • URL Request url_in
  • Public or 404? norm_check
  • Valid Auth? auth_check
  • /login?redirect redirect_login
  • PBAC & Sync? pbac_check
  • /not-authorized deny_403
  • Context & Feature? ctx_check
  • Shell Gate show_ctx_gate
  • Render Page render_page
  • auth_check → pbac_check · yes
  • auth_check → redirect_login · no
  • ctx_check → render_page · ok
  • ctx_check → show_ctx_gate · missing
  • norm_check → auth_check · protected
  • norm_check → render_page · public
  • pbac_check → ctx_check · yes
  • pbac_check → deny_403 · no
  • url_in → norm_check
  1. Public or 404? ↗

    Public routes load cleanly, and unknown paths pass through to not-found.tsx without redirect leaks.

  2. Valid Auth? ↗

    Unauthenticated requests redirect to /login?redirect=safe with XSS/backslash validation in proxy.ts and RouteGuard.

  3. PBAC & Sync? ↗

    Holds spinner until routesContextKey syncs, then runs fail-closed canAccessPage and AuthorizedRouteDescriptor checks.

  4. Context & Feature? ↗

    Intercepts missing tenant/platform context or disabled features in DashboardLayout without mounting page children.

How do route classification rules prevent bypasses?

Every Next.js page.tsx template maps to exactly one manifest binding, keeping public routes minimal and module routes server-governed.3

Manifest BindingCountIncluded RoutesEnforcement Rule
public16Auth forms, callbacks, /signup/finalize, /bookings/guest, /privacy, /terms, /not-authorizedAnonymous allowed; devOnly entries blocked in prod
shell_authenticated17/, /hub, /overview, /settings exact, /activate-workspace, /change-password, /account/*, dev /sileo-playgroundAuthenticated session + fail-closed PAGE_PERMISSIONS; zero module prefixes
menu_bound159/crm/**, /settings/*, /data-exchange/**, /venue/**, /analytics/**, /customization/**, /plugins/**, previewsRequires auth, fail-closed PBAC, AuthorizedRouteDescriptor, and active context

SupportsTenantGuidance & WIP Isolation

All 24 modified backend files and 6 untracked migrations for SupportsTenantGuidance were reverted, TENANT_SCOPED_GUIDANCE_PAGES and tenantGuidanceRoutes were stripped from 10 frontend files with NAV_STORE_VERSION = 3, and all 48 unrelated frontend WIP files remain intact.
